title: Adventure

tables.caption: Fitness Profile Match
rows: Technical climbs, monkey park steep stairs if low energy, Fushimi full summit loop in heat

tables.caption: 1. Kamakura Coastal Walk — Day 4 (Scheduled)
rows: Daibutsu approach walk + Enoden coastal tram + optional Enoshima island climb
Walking shoes, sunscreen, ¥500 coin for lockers
Enoden sea view; Fuji on clear days

tables.caption: 3. Arashiyama Nature Loop — Day 10 (Scheduled)
rows: Bamboo grove → Tenryu-ji → Katsura river path
Iwatayama Monkey Park — 120 m climb, 20 min steep; skip if hot
Sagano Romantic Train (book ahead) — scenic not hike

tables.caption: 4. Philosopher's Path — Day 11 (Scheduled)
rows: Kiyomizu dawn descent → taxi/bus to path → Ginkaku-ji

tables.caption: Kamikochi Alpine Valley — Swap for Day 7 OR extra Takayama day
rows: Premier #1 nature hit — Azusa River, Hotaka peaks views
Bus from Matsumoto or Takayama area (~2.5–3 hr each way from Takayama — long day)
Stay Takayama; tour bus Jul 30 early — replaces Shirakawa-go if already seen OR skip market
Kappa Bridge loop 1.5 hr easy; Myojin Pond 2–3 hr moderate flat
Moderate; no climbing required for valley floor

bullets.heading: Safety & Season
items: Heat exhaustion: Rest 11:00–15:00 indoor on Aug 1–3 Kyoto hikes.
Thunderstorms: Alps afternoon — descend Kamikochi by 14:00 if cells build.
Bears: Kamikochi — rare on main trails; bell not required on crowded paths.
Solo hiking: Japan trail culture safe; tell hotel front desk if solo alpine bus day.
